BE/OwnershipAndControl/Executives/Signat.label: signatory
BE/OwnershipAndControl/Executives/Signat.definition: responsible party authorized to sign agreements on behalf of themselves, another person, or an organization

BE/Trusts/Trusts/Trustee.label: trustee
BE/Trusts/Trusts/Trustee.definition: party that holds and manages assets for the benefit of another

FBC/DebtAndEquities/CreditEvents/WriteDo.label: write-down
FBC/DebtAndEquities/CreditEvents/WriteDo.definition: obligation-specific credit event whereby the book value of the obligation, such as the outstanding principal amount, is reduced

FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/Borrower.label: borrower
FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/Borrower.definition: party to a credit agreement that is obligated to repay the amount borrowed (principal) with interest and other fees according to the terms of the instrument

FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/Collateral.label: collateral
FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/Collateral.definition: something pledged as security to ensure fulfillment of an obligation to another party, to lend money, extend credit, or provision securities

FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/DebtTerms.label: debt terms
FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/DebtTerms.definition: contract terms that specify the formal rights and obligations of borrower and lender under a contract in which funds are lent from the one party to the other

FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/FixedInterestRa.label: fixed interest rate
FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/FixedInterestRa.definition: interest rate that does not fluctuate over the lifetime of a loan or other debt instrument

FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/hasCreditLimit.label: has credit limit
FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/hasCreditLimit.definition: specifies the maximum amount of credit that may be borrowed with respect to a specific agreement (e.g. for line of credit)

FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/hasInterestRate.label: has interest rate
FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/hasInterestRate.definition: relates something, such as an agreement, or debt instrument, to the rate (typically annual) of interest that is to be paid by the debtor to the creditor on the debt

FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/hasMaturityDate.label: has maturity date
FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/hasMaturityDate.definition: indicates the date on which the principal amount of an instrument is due to be repaid to the investor and interest or coupon payments stop, and/or the date on which the instrument may be redeemed

FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/RevolvingLineOf.label: revolving line of credit
FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/RevolvingLineOf.definition: credit facility that enables the borrower to withdraw funds, repay, and withdraw again

FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/VariableInteres.label: variable interest rate
FBC/DebtAndEquities/Debt/VariableInteres.definition: an interest rate that is allowed to vary over the maturity of a loan or other debt instrument

FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServices.label: bank
FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServices.definition: depository institution, usually a corporation, that accepts deposits, makes loans, pays checks, and performs related services, for individual members of the public, businesses or other organizations

FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServices.label: banking product
FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServices.definition: product provided to consumers and businesses by a depository institution

FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServices.label: credit union
FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServices.definition: not-for-profit depository institution that makes personal loans and offers other consumer banking services, organized for the purpose of promoting thrift among its members and creating a source of credit for provident or productive purposes

FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.label: branch of a depository institution
FBC/FunctionalEntities/NorthAmericanEnti.definition: any office or any place of business located in any State of the United States at which deposits are received

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: account
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: container for records associated with a business arrangement for regular transactions and services

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: customer account
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: account that represents an identified, named collection of balances and cumulative totals used to summarize customer transaction-related activity over a designated period of time

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: deposit account
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: account that provides a record of money placed with a depository institution for safekeeping and management

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: has balance
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: relates an account to the net amount of money available in that account

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: has close date
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: relates something to the date that it was closed

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: has open date
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: relates something to the date that it was created

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: has payment due date
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: indicates the date by which payment of some amount must be made to the creditor

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: has primary account holder
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: relates an account to a client or customer that is considered the primary owner of the account

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: individual transaction
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: event that has a monetary impact and is documented in the records associated with an account

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: non-transaction deposit account
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: any deposit account that is not explicitly considered a transaction account

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: time deposit account
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: deposit account that the depositor does not have a right, and is not permitted, to make withdrawals from within six days after the date of deposit unless the deposit is subject to an early withdrawal penalty of at least seven days' simple interest on amounts withdrawn within the first six days after deposit

FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.label: transaction deposit account
FBC/ProductsAndServices/ClientsAndAccoun.definition: deposit account from which the depositor / account holder is permitted to make transfers or withdrawals by negotiable / transferable instruments, payment orders of withdrawal, telephone transfers, and so forth, and that may be accessible via an electronic device such as an automated teller machine (ATM), remote service unit (RSU), mobile device, and by debit card

FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProduct.label: dealer
FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProduct.definition: any party that purchases goods or services for resale and acts on their own behalf in a transaction

FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasDateOfBirt.label: has date of birth
FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasDateOfBirt.definition: identifies the date on which an individual was born

FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasDateOfDeat.label: has date of death
FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasDateOfDeat.definition: identifies the date on which an individual died

FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasFirstName.label: has first name
FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasFirstName.definition: indicates the given name or first name of a person, that is, the name chosen for them at birth or changed by them subsequently from the name given at birth

FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasLastName.label: has last name
FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasLastName.definition: indicates the name shared in common to identify the members of a family, as distinguished from each member's given name

FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasMiddleName.label: has middle name or initial
FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasMiddleName.definition: one or more additional names or initial letters for names that occur between a person's first and last name

FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasNamePrefix.label: has name prefix
FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasNamePrefix.definition: indicates a character or sequence of characters, preceding a person's name, that provides additional information about the person, such as a form of address representing a title, honorific, or military rank

FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasNameSuffix.label: has name suffix
FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/hasNameSuffix.definition: indicates a character or sequence of characters, following a person's name, that provides additional information about the person, such as their position, educational degree, accreditation, office, or honor

FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/Person.label: person
FND/AgentsAndPeople/People/Person.definition: individual human being, with consciousness of self

FND/Agreements/Agreements/Beneficiary.label: beneficiary
FND/Agreements/Agreements/Beneficiary.definition: party that receives some benefit or advantage or profits from something

FND/Agreements/Contracts/hasTerm.label: has term
FND/Agreements/Contracts/hasTerm.definition: indicates a fixed or limited period for which something, e.g., a contract, an investment, or an offer, lasts or is intended to last

FND/Arrangements/Ratings/hasRatingScore.label: has rating score
FND/Arrangements/Ratings/hasRatingScore.definition: indicates the grade or score associated with a rating with respect to a particular rating scale

FND/Arrangements/Ratings/QuantitativeRat.label: quantitative rating score
FND/Arrangements/Ratings/QuantitativeRat.definition: rating score that is a simple numeric value on some scale, such as a credit rating for an individual

FND/Arrangements/Reporting/Report.label: report
FND/Arrangements/Reporting/Report.definition: document that provides a structured description of something, prepared on ad hoc, periodic, recurring, regular, or as required basis

FND/DatesAndTimes/FinancialDates/hasAsOf.label: has as-of date
FND/DatesAndTimes/FinancialDates/hasAsOf.definition: relates something to the date on which it is accurate or valid (e.g. a credit report has an asOfDate that means the date when the information was drawn)

FND/Organizations/FormalOrganizations/Em.label: employee
FND/Organizations/FormalOrganizations/Em.definition: person in the service of another under any contract of hire, express or implied, oral or written, where the employer has the right to control and direct that person in the material details of how the work is to be performed

FND/Organizations/FormalOrganizations/Em.label: employer
FND/Organizations/FormalOrganizations/Em.definition: party that provides compensation, including wages or a salary and potentially other benefits, in exchange for work performed by one or more people, and that has the right to control and direct the employee in the material details of how the work is to be performed

FND/Places/Addresses/hasPostalCode.label: has postal code
FND/Places/Addresses/hasPostalCode.definition: the postal code of this address as specified by the local postal service

FND/Places/Addresses/hasStreetAddress.label: has street address
FND/Places/Addresses/hasStreetAddress.definition: indicates a fully-specified address component that consists of a primary address number, predirectional, street name, suffix, postdirectional, and an optional secondary unit

FND/Places/VirtualPlaces/hasElectronicMa.label: has electronic mail address
FND/Places/VirtualPlaces/hasElectronicMa.definition: specifies an electronic messaging endpoint at which some entity may be located or contacted or may receive correspondence

FND/Places/VirtualPlaces/hasTelephoneNum.label: has telephone number
FND/Places/VirtualPlaces/hasTelephoneNum.definition: indicates a virtual address composed of a sequence of digits and symbols that may be assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station, a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or other similar device or service

FND/ProductsAndServices/PaymentsAndSched.label: has payment amount
FND/ProductsAndServices/PaymentsAndSched.definition: specifies the amount of money involved in a payment

FND/ProductsAndServices/ProductsAndServi.label: customer
FND/ProductsAndServices/ProductsAndServi.definition: party that receives or consumes products (goods or services) and has the ability to choose between different products and suppliers

LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoanApplications/hasOr.label: has original loan debt-to-income ratio
LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoanApplications/hasOr.definition: indicates the debt-to-income (DTI) ratio at the time when the loan was advanced; for combined income

LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoanApplications/LoanA.label: loan application
LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoanApplications/LoanA.definition: request by a potential borrower to a potential lender to borrow money containing information used to decide whether to grant the loan

LOAN/LoansGeneral/Loans/hasLoanBalance.label: has loan balance
LOAN/LoansGeneral/Loans/hasLoanBalance.definition: indicates the balance with respect to the principal on the loan as of some date

LOAN/LoansGeneral/Loans/hasPrincipalAmou.label: has principal amount
LOAN/LoansGeneral/Loans/hasPrincipalAmou.definition: indicates the nominal amount of the loan that must be paid at or before maturity

LOAN/LoansGeneral/Loans/Loan.label: loan
LOAN/LoansGeneral/Loans/Loan.definition: debt instrument whereby one party extends money or credit to another party (or parties) with the understanding that the borrowed money will be repaid according to the terms of the contract

LOAN/LoansGeneral/Loans/LoanToValueRatio.label: loan-to-value ratio
LOAN/LoansGeneral/Loans/LoanToValueRatio.definition: ratio, expressed as a percentage, between the principal amount of the loan and the appraised value of the asset securing the financing

LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/CardExpi.label: card expiration date
LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/CardExpi.definition: date on which a given payment card expires

LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/CardProd.label: card product
LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/CardProd.definition: financial product involving the issuance of credit, debit, or other payment cards

LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/CreditCa.label: credit card
LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/CreditCa.definition: card issued by a financial service provider that enables the cardholder to borrow funds

LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/CreditCa.label: credit card account
LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/CreditCa.definition: card account whose terms and conditions are defined in a credit card agreement that is represented by a credit card

LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/DebitCar.label: debit card
LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/DebitCar.definition: payment card issued by a financial service provider that enables the cardholder to access funds in a demand deposit account

LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/PaymentC.label: payment card
LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/PaymentC.definition: legal document issued by a financial services provider that enables the cardholder to access the funds in the customer's designated bank accounts, or through a credit account and make payments by electronic funds transfer and access automated teller machines (ATMs)

LOAN/LoansSpecific/CommercialLoans/Comme.label: commercial loan
LOAN/LoansSpecific/CommercialLoans/Comme.definition: loan extended to a corporation, commercial enterprise, joint venture, or other organization as opposed to a consumer

LOAN/LoansSpecific/ConsumerLoans/Consume.label: consumer loan
LOAN/LoansSpecific/ConsumerLoans/Consume.definition: loan to one or more individuals for household, family, or other personal expenditures, excluding mortgages and student loans

LOAN/LoansSpecific/ConsumerLoans/HomeEqu.label: home equity line of credit
LOAN/LoansSpecific/ConsumerLoans/HomeEqu.definition: line of credit granted to a homeowner secured by the equity value in a borrower's home or other property

LOAN/LoansSpecific/ConsumerLoans/MotorVe.label: motor vehicle loan
LOAN/LoansSpecific/ConsumerLoans/MotorVe.definition: collateralized, simple-interest loan that is repaid in monthly installments over a period of typically three to five years, for the purpose of purchasing a vehicle

LOAN/LoansSpecific/LoanProducts/LoanProd.label: loan product
LOAN/LoansSpecific/LoanProducts/LoanProd.definition: financial product that is realized as a loan that a party may acquire from a lending institution with specific characteristics and terms

LOAN/RealEstateLoans/Mortgages/ClosedEnd.label: closed-end mortgage loan
LOAN/RealEstateLoans/Mortgages/ClosedEnd.definition: loan secured by real estate with no ability for the borrower to receive additional funds under the loan at a later date
